files.content: import unittest from solution import decode_inventory class DecodeInventoryTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_decodes_document_order_and_trims_descriptions(self): xml = '\n First item \nSecond & final\n' self.assertEqual(decode_inventory(xml), [ {"code": "A", "quantity": 0, "details": {"description": "First item"}}, {"code": "B", "quantity": 12, "details": {"description": "Second & final"}}, ]) def test_empty_inventory(self): self.assertEqual(decode_inventory(""), []) self.assertEqual(decode_inventory(" \n "), []) def test_nested_details_are_independent(self): result = decode_inventory('onetwo') self.assertIsNot(result[0], result[1]) self.assertIsNot(result[0]["details"], result[1]["details"]) result[0]["details"]["description"] = "changed" self.assertEqual(result[1]["details"]["description"], "two") def test_malformed_and_structurally_invalid_xml(self): invalid = [ "", "", '', "text", '', 'x', '', '', '', '', '', 'unexpected', ] for xml in invalid: with self.subTest(xml=xml): with self.assertRaises(ValueError): decode_inventory(xml) with self.assertRaises(ValueError): decode_inventory(b"") if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
